author: andrewgcodes
name: Optimized Architecture v11
blurb: SP-1024 10x512 KV4 with very large bigram (16384x64), MLP 3x, SWA (every 25 steps), RoPE, Muon weight decay (0.08), 10-layer architecture with Int5 MLP quantization, enhanced test-time training (5 epochs SGD lr=0.003, full model adaptation), sliding window eval (stride=64), and int8+zlib roundtrip.
